name: United States of the Ionian Islands (1815–1864)
description: A blue field bordered in red with the Union Jack in the canton and the winged lion of St Mark holding a gospel book and seven arrows in the fly.
history: Flag of the United States of the Ionian Islands, the British protectorate over the seven islands from 1815 until their cession to Greece in 1864.

features.role: winged lion of St Mark with seven arrows
